sloka: अतिमात्रप्रहर्षोऽयं किं जनस्य च शंस मे ।कारयिष्यति किं वापि संप्रहृष्टो महीपतिः ॥२-७-९॥
transliteration: atimātrapraharṣo'yaṁ kiṁ janasya ca śaṁsa me ।kārayiṣyati kiṁ vāpi saṁprahṛṣṭo mahīpatiḥ ॥2-7-9॥

translations.english: Why do the people look exceedingly happy? Tell me, what the king with great delight is proposing to do?
